Research

Research Interests

Online platform operations; pricing and revenue management; consumer choice and demand estimation; product development and experimentation.

Methods: Bayesian optimization and Gaussian processes; convex optimization; discrete-choice modeling; dynamic programming; game theory; maximum likelihood and hierarchical Bayes estimation.
